_doc: Baseline for tools/lint_mask_primitive.py. Every mask function under systemu/ (name contains mask/redact/scrub) that does NOT reach the shared span primitive messaging.gateway.mask_secret_spans, with the reason it may. Enforced both ways: a mask function not listed here fails, and an entry that now reaches the primitive (or is gone) fails until it is deleted -- this list only shrinks. 'kind' is one of: primitive-internal (part of the primitive itself), whole-value (replaces the entire value, no span left to mask), identity (removes a KNOWN value by equality, not by shape), structural (drops a structural part of a parsed value), predicate (returns a bool, masks nothing), residual (a known gap, listed so it is visible -- not a permission).

functions.reason: The re.sub replacement callback of the primitive's own header/kv rule. mask_secret_spans calls it, so it cannot call mask_secret_spans.

The known-value fence: replaces any token EQUAL to a stored credential (matched by keyed digest). It is the complement mask_outbound composes AFTER the primitive, for secrets no shape rule can see; running the shape rules here would only repeat them.
Per-token helper of redact_known_secrets (the known-value fence).
Renders a stored credential as '<redacted:last4>' for display. The whole value is replaced; there is no surrounding text to span-mask.
Removes the ONE key being stored from a keyring backend's exception text, by equality (text.replace(secret, mask_secret(secret))). The value is known exactly, so no shape rule is needed.
Masks the password of the configured Redis broker URL for a log line by parsing it (urlsplit) and rebuilding the netloc with '***'. The input is a config URL, not free text.
Returns a bool (does the args preview name a secret?); it masks nothing itself.
